University of Waterloo thesis credits Fela with founding Afrobeat and calls the New Afrika Shrine in Ikeja, Lagos, the first Afrobeat nightclub and home; supports a major scene center, not sole invention.
Wits says roots lie across Gauteng, particularly Pretoria and Johannesburg; Pretoria is an early center, not exclusive origin.
ABC says began in Rio late 1950s and notes concurrent São Paulo scene; Brazilian music dictionary records early Rio bossa nova concert in 1957.
Oxford Academic chapter directly states late-19th-century calypso developed in the burgeoning urban city of Port of Spain.
UH Libraries explicitly calls Houston the birthplace of chopped and screwed and identifies DJ Screw as originator.
MOPOP documents Seattle’s grunge explosion and Seattle bands, with broader Puget Sound context.

University of Education Winneba article traces highlife foundations across Ghanaian traditions and multiple institutions in 1880s–1920s; supports Ghanaian origin but not Accra as exclusive origin, so medium hub association.
LOC links the 1973 beginning with a South Bronx party; PBS treats the exact Sedgwick birthplace claim as contested/investigative. Bronx association strong; no singular origin asserted.

KQED oral history locates hyphy within Bay Area hip-hop; identifies the term as first recorded by East Oakland’s Keak Da Sneak and discusses Oakland participants. Supports Oakland association, though hyphy was regional rather than exclusively Oakland.
National Park Service jazz history traces jazz formation to New Orleans and its distinctive late-19th/early-20th-century musical mix; directly supports the city-origin association.
Smithsonian Folkways states that Tuva’s throat-singing is called Khöömei and describes it as a Tuvan vocal tradition; directly supports this geographic association.

South African Department of Education answer key explicitly says kwaito developed in Johannesburg in the 1990s. Gavin Steingo’s peer-reviewed article complicates a single simplified origin narrative, so retain Johannesburg but avoid implying one uncontested inventor/event.

Beijing municipal history says Huiju came from Anhui and other regions; Four Great Anhui Troupes brought it to Beijing in 1790 and the form congealed there by 1840–60. Beijing is a key development/formation center, not the source tradition’s sole birthplace; qualify relation wording.

Dancecult ethnomusicology article says psyculture is rooted in seasonal dance-party culture evolving in Goa in the 1970s/80s; Goa trance and later psytrance are diverse, globally formed descendants. Supports Goa as scene/precursor, not exclusive origin of the later genre.

UNESCO Caribbean cultural-resources report identifies reggae as Jamaican heritage and Kingston as UNESCO City of Music; it does not establish Kingston as reggae’s birthplace. Revise this edge to a scene/hub relation or cite stronger evidence for birthplace.
UNESCO joint Argentina–Uruguay nomination says tango originated among working classes in Buenos Aires and Montevideo in the Río de la Plata basin; supports both city links and shared origin.

Guardian article explicitly calls Bristol the birthplace/spiritual home of trip-hop and documents the Wild Bunch and local studios/labels as scene infrastructure.

Library of Congress says hip-hop is commonly dated to a 1973 South Bronx party and traces deeper musical precursors. Supports New York broadly; Bronx is the more precise origin node, so confidence for city-wide relation is medium.
Manchester University Press chapter summary locates jungle’s emergence in 1990s East London hardcore circuits and analyzes its Black British and diasporic context; strong direct support.
Guardian reports Hand was born and raised in Detroit, was a Detroit dance-scene DJ/producer, and founded labels there; strongly supports the association.
Detroit Historical Society says Kevin Saunderson formed KMS Records in 1985 after involvement in Detroit techno; directly supports Detroit association.

Cambridge chapter identifies Kraftwerk as Düsseldorf pioneers but stresses Krautrock was a heterogeneous retrospective label spanning distinct scenes including West Berlin, Munich and Düsseldorf/Cologne. Düsseldorf is one important center, not a singular origin; revise relation to scene/hub.

Beggars Group identifies 4AD as one of its labels and traces Beggars’ origins to London. This establishes the corporate group’s London provenance, but does not independently establish 4AD’s own founding address; retain medium pending label-specific founding evidence.
Blue Note’s official anniversary history says founder Alfred Lion held its first recording session in New York City on 6 January 1939; directly supports origin city.
BMI says the Williams brothers were New Orleans-area natives and founded Cash Money in 1991. This supports association with New Orleans, but does not establish the exact founding location.
Chess Records’ official site calls the label Chicago-based and identifies its establishment in 1950; directly supports the Chicago association.
Official discography lists Respect on Otis Blue (1965), and Stax identifies it among Redding’s classic singles; direct recording credit confirmed.
